system.description:
Samurai Exclusive. [Trigger: Move] This main process adds +2Sq to the range of this weapon's [Ranged Attack] that you perform with it. Additionally, the target of [Ranged Attack] cannot roll two or more dice for [Defense Check]. A twisted bow made from the bones of a monster. It has a cursed ability that allows it to pierce targets from any distance by binding them.

Twisted Horn [Core Material] (120G) + Composite Bow (230G) + [Magic Catalyst 7] (60G) × 3 + Crafting Cost (230G)
